from openpyxl import Workbook

# Read the CSV file
with open('general-fund-donors-board.csv', 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()[1:]  # Skip header

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = 'Exhibition Sponsors'

# Add header
ws['A1'] = 'Donor'
ws['B1'] = 'Amount'
ws['C1'] = 'Note'

# Add data rows
for i, line in enumerate(lines, start=2):
    parts = line.strip().split(',')
    donor = parts[0]
    try:
        amount = float(parts[1])
    except:
        amount = parts[1]
    note = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else ''
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=donor)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2, value=amount)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=3, value=note)

# Save workbook
wb.save('general-fund-donors-board.xlsx')
print('Excel file created successfully')
